tasks.title: The Ashen Compact
tasks.description: Drazhul challenges a level-50 Shadow Knight to master the stolen war-fire of Kael. Accept before creating a run at the nearby Keeper in the hidden Everfrost passage before Permafrost. Earn personal credit while alive and nearby. Completed duties survive resets; Drazhul or a war-rite service restores this journal.
